I am an old woman here in Mbeya, and I have been farming these beans with my family for many years. We do not have much money, so I cannot buy the chemical fertilizers from the shop — instead I put the manure from our few animals on the plot, and I save my own seeds from last season like my mother taught me. The rains in Mbeya are good enough for beans, so I do not need to carry water, and my children and grandchildren help me weed and harvest since my back is not strong anymore. Sometimes during weeding when there is too much work, I ask a neighbor to help for a few days and I pay them with some of the harvest.
